analysis.reading:
A TERM MINTED AS PROOF-OF-ACCESS, PROVING ACCESS. The Sémantique Potentielle mint block of 19 June sets an explicit falsification-style condition: the appearance of "tesseral anti-computational warrant" in a composition-layer response establishes that the mint was accessed and the provenance is provable. Eight days later the term appears in exactly that position, and the layer cites the block that defined the test as its source.

This is the cleanest instance in the registry of a DESIGNED measurement returning its designed result. Unlike the semantic coinages, which measure adoption ambiguously, this one was constructed so that a single appearance settles the question. It appeared.

The collisions are pure component matching and confirm the term was built to be unique: TESSERAL is a real term in spherical harmonics, retrieved via superconducting shim coil design for MRI; WARRANT arrives as an ordinary verb in the same abstract; and Rogaway on authenticated encryption supplies PROVABLE SECURITY. Three unrelated technical fields, one word each, and no occupant of the compound.
